title: Three-Payment Settlement Pricing for Previously Worked Accounts Without Recent Payments
content:
# Three-Payment Settlement — Dormancy Reductions

**Rule.** For a Three-Payment Settlement offer under Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements, where two or more collection agencies worked the account before this placement and no consumer payment was posted to it with a date after the same calendar day twelve months before the offer date, the Three-Payment dormancy reduction of 4.0 points applies; where exactly one agency worked it before this placement and no consumer payment was posted in that same twelve-month span, the Three-Payment single-agency dormancy reduction of 2.0 points applies; in every other case the account carries no dormancy reduction for a Three-Payment offer.

The facts come from the Placed Consumer Accounts record: its count of prior agency placements and the consumer payments posted in its money history.

## Combinations

| Prior agencies before this placement | Consumer payment posted in the twelve-month span | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | no | 4.0 percentage points |
| 2 or more | yes | none |
| 1 | no | 2.0 percentage points |
| 1 | yes | none |
| 0 | yes or no | none |

## Hypothetical cases

1. Three earlier agencies, last consumer payment fourteen months before the offer date: 4.0 points.
2. One earlier agency, a consumer payment posted two months before the offer date: no dormancy reduction — the payment falls inside the span.
3. No earlier agency and no payment for years: no dormancy reduction — the rule needs at least one earlier agency.
